title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
annotation_basis: Manually checked against the cached Chinese manual subtitles on 2026-11-02. These five development questions cover four topics, including two phrasings of the activation-range question. They are not a held-out benchmark and do not measure model answer accuracy.

questions.question: 视频示例的输入层有多少个神经元？输入数字 0 和 1 分别代表什么？
questions.reference_answer: 输入层有 784 个神经元，每个对应一个像素的灰度值；0 表示黑色，1 表示白色。这里描述的是该示例的输入编码。
questions.manual_review_notes: Check that the answer distinguishes input pixel encoding from every hidden neuron's possible activation range. No independent audio or image verification was performed for this annotation.

questions.question: 视频说这个示例网络大约有多少个可调整的权重和偏置参数？这里的学习是在寻找什么？
questions.reference_answer: 视频将总数概括为大约 13,000 个权重和偏置，即可调整参数；学习是让计算机找到能解决问题的合适参数。13,000 是视频的近似表述。
questions.manual_review_notes: Do not present the rounded spoken 13,000 as an exact independently counted total. The subtitle around 12:02 has ambiguous wording about per-neuron versus per-layer biases; this question does not rely on it.

questions.question: 为什么演示采用两个隐藏层、每层 16 个神经元？视频把这个结构当作通用设计建议了吗？
questions.reference_answer: 两个隐藏层和每层 16 个神经元是为了可视化、版面和看得清楚；讲者接着说明实际结构会根据实验调整，因此不能将演示布局理解为通用推荐。最后一句是结合上下文的判断。

required_windows.label: visual layout choice and practical architecture variation

questions.manual_review_notes: The answer should retain the limitation that the demonstrated size was selected for explanation rather than claiming an optimized architecture.

questions.question: 前面说神经元激活值介于 0 和 1，是否意味着所有神经网络都必须如此？结合开头的限定、Sigmoid 示例与结尾 ReLU 讨论解释。
questions.reference_answer: 不是。开头已经说实际不止于此；中段说明本例用 Sigmoid 把任意实数的加权总和压到 0 和 1 之间；结尾介绍 ReLU 返回 0 与输入值的最大值。因此 ReLU 没有 1 的上界是从其定义得到的数学推论。

required_windows.label: weighted sum and example-specific Sigmoid range
ReLU training qualification and max definition

questions.manual_review_notes: This question deliberately names Sigmoid and ReLU, so it supplies useful retrieval terms; see the unassisted paraphrase for a less directed query. At 17:19 the Chinese subtitle says weights are between 0 and 1, which conflicts with the preceding description of weighted sums and activations. Original audio and the relevant visual frames have not been verified.

questions.question: 视频里的神经元激活值是不是一定不能超过 1？
questions.reference_answer: 不是普遍规则。开头就有实际不止于此的限定，中段的 0 到 1 是本例 Sigmoid 的输出范围，结尾 ReLU 定义允许大于 1 的输入直接成为输出。后一项是数学推论。

required_windows.label: ReLU training qualification and max definition
